speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: My joiner was here at first light. It is the house's latch, Master Shakespeare, and not the lodger's. Put your purse away.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He had tools on the stair. I can pay the man.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You can pay the quarter, which is why I am standing here with a pen. The man is paid by the house. Mark me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty shillings. Christmas is Thursday. I shall be up the river, so you have it now, three days early.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Count it twice. I write once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten, and ten. Twenty shillings. Again. Ten, and ten.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twenty shillings, the Christmas quarter, brought forward. I will write it in my husband's hand, which the parish can read if I cannot be asked.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Aired. The coffer unvisited. I have not a key, and I shall not grow one while you are gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gib sleeps on whatever is warmest.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib may sleep on the bed, or on me. He may not sleep on the lord's book. I will put him off it myself if he tries, and I will not tell you each time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book stays. I am not carrying it to Richmond.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. A chronicle is a bad fellow in a damp boat. Hold the sand.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. Twenty shillings. Received of Master Shakespeare, this twenty-second of December, for the Christmas quarter, by me, Dorcas Ansell. You may see it. You may not improve it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not improve it. The latch is yours, and the twenty are paid.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Try the door once more before you go down to the river. If it sticks, it is still mine. If it shuts, go and play, and come back wet if you must. I did not undertake the weather.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It shuts. God keep you, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: God keep you. And do not pay me twice for a thing I have already refused.
